core_obligations: Setup (proof lines 7992-8001): the total site is built from the simplicial object U of (Spaces/S)_ph; the right-hand topoi may be represented by the spaces-etale sites (the author's footnote on the fppf-variant notation is preserved).

Case A (lines 8004-8010): both (Spaces/U)_{ph,total} and U_{spaces,etale} fall into case A of the simplicial-site situation - immediate from the construction of U_etale, and via the fibre-product lemma for the total site.

The morphism of simplicial sites (lines 8011-8024): the component functors U |-> U/U_n and U |-> U/X are morphisms of sites (the a_{U_n} and a_X of the ph-etale comparison in More on Cohomology of Spaces); they are compatible with the augmentations as in the remark, and the augmentation-morphism lemma for simplicial sites yields the commutative diagram of topoi of the statement.
proof_roadmap: Place both simplicial sites in case A of the simplicial-site situation.
Identify the component morphisms of sites with the a_{U_n}, a_X of the ph-etale comparison.
Apply the morphism-of-augmented-simplicial-sites lemma to conclude the diagram.
difficulty_reason: Comparison lemma (statement 7972-7989, proof 7991-8024): the ph twin of the fppf-etale comparison - the case-A placements are definitional from the constructions, the component morphisms are the established a_{U_n}, a_X of the ph-etale section, and the conclusion is an application of the chapter's augmentation-morphism lemma for simplicial sites; no verification is omitted. H2: infrastructure lemma assembling established morphisms.
